instructions.button-press-v3: reach forward and press the red button on the desk
instructions.door-open-v3: grasp the door handle and pull the door open
instructions.window-open-v3: push the sliding window handle sideways to open the window
instructions.faucet-open-v3: turn the faucet handle counterclockwise to open the water tap
instructions.drawer-open-v3: grasp the drawer handle and pull the drawer open
instructions.drawer-close-v3: push the open drawer inward to close the drawer
instructions.handle-press-v3: push down firmly on the lever handle until pressed
instructions.coffee-button-v3: reach to the coffee machine and press the brew button

button-press-v3: depress the crimson switch mounted on the tabletop
move the gripper ahead and tap down the tabletop button
door-open-v3: latch onto the handle and swing the miniature door outward
seize the grip bar to open the hinged door panel
grab the knob on the small door and yank it open
window-open-v3: slide the casement sash laterally along the track
shove the glass pane latch horizontally until it opens
glide the window grip to the side to unseal the pane
faucet-open-v3: rotate the spigot valve anticlockwise to turn on water
twist the tap lever leftwards so water flows
spin the faucet knob counter clockwise to release water
drawer-open-v3: grab the front grip and slide out the storage tray
hold the drawer knob and draw the compartment toward you
drawer-close-v3: shut the extended cabinet tray by shoving it back in
press the pulled out drawer front inward until flush
push the cabinet drawer completely inside
handle-press-v3: force the bar switch straight downward completely
apply downward pressure onto the crank lever to engage it
depress the mechanical handle straight down to the base
coffee-button-v3: tap the espresso maker switch to start brewing
move toward the coffee brewer and activate the brew pad
press the start button located on the espresso machine
